title: Designing & Creating an AR Model Prototype

items.title: Lesson Podcast
items.description: Audio walkthrough of planning purpose, audience, assets and triggers; choosing design tools; and building a working AR prototype.

items.title: How computers learn to recognize objects instantly — Joseph Redmon TED
items.description: Image-recognition triggers are central to AR prototypes — this TED talk shows the computer vision that fires your AR overlays.

items.title: 100+ Web Development Things you Should Know — Fireship
items.description: Covers design prototyping, asset creation and iterative build processes — the same workflow you will follow creating your AR model.

items.title: You Should Learn to Program — Christian Genco TEDxSMU
items.description: Encourages a maker mindset — exactly what you need when creating a prototype AR experience from scratch.

items.title: Ex Machina (2015)
items.description: A designer creates an AI interface and tests it with a real user — the film mirrors the design-build-test cycle of your AR prototype.

items.title: CoSpaces Edu — Build AR & 3D Scenes in Your Browser
items.description: The tool most schools use for OCR J836 AR prototypes — create, animate and share AR scenes directly in your browser.

items.title: OCR Cambridge Nationals IT — Specification at a Glance
items.description: Review exactly what OCR expects for the AR prototype task — purpose, audience, assets and triggers are all assessed.
